
Dear users,

1. Please put all the source and header codes under the folder "src" in LAMMPS.
Then compile the LAMMPS by using "gnu_g++", it has been tested under the OpenMPI.

2. Please run the MATLAB script "create_rbc_with_water" to generate the initial configurations 
first before simulation.

3. The attached input file "in_example" is a short run code for red blood cell simulations.

4. The output is shown in the section 4.5 where the trajectory file can be read by VMD.
